CHORALE first creates one common representation and then asks several different
questions of it. Those questions have different estimands, null distributions
and interpretations, and are reported separately for that reason.

## 1. Fix the vocabulary and measure coverage

`chorale_concepts()` builds the vocabulary before any phenotype result is
examined. Genes and proteins reach concepts through identifier mappings. Lipids
reach compatible pathway concepts through lipid class. A custom named list of
feature identifiers works as well.

Coverage is recorded for every concept and modality. “Not expressed” means that
the modality contains fewer than the requested number of concept members, so the
term describes the reach of the assay's annotation rather than the state of the
biology.

## 2. Put each modality on an appropriate scale

`chorale_transform()` handles within-feature measurement scale: count-like data
receive a variance-stabilising transform, skewed positive intensities receive
`log1p`, and already symmetric data are left unchanged. Samples must already be
normalised within modality for library size, total intensity, or the equivalent
platform-specific exposure.

Each feature is then centred and scaled across the samples of its own modality.
This prevents a high-abundance feature from dominating solely because of its
unit or baseline.

## 3. Score the concepts without reading the phenotype

For each sample, a concept score is the weighted mean of the standardised
features that carry that concept. Scores are standardised again within modality.
`chorale_encode()` does not consult the design, so a phenotype contrast cannot
choose or rotate the representation that will later be tested.

From here the workflow branches.

## Branch A: named concept evidence

### 4A. Estimate an adjusted effect in each modality

`chorale_concept_evidence()` regresses each concept score on the phenotype and
the covariates that all modalities can represent consistently. Continuous
covariates contribute standardised slopes. Categorical covariates contribute
treatment contrasts over shared levels.

The effect is measured in standard deviations of the concept score. An effect
of 0.8 means that, after adjustment, the compared phenotype level is estimated
to sit 0.8 concept-score standard deviations above the reference level.

### 5A. Combine, but keep disagreement visible

Effects are combined by inverse-variance weighting. A precise modality receives
more weight; opposite directions cancel. `sign_agreement` reports the fraction
of modalities pointing with the combined effect. `heterogeneity_p` tests for
more disagreement than the standard errors predict. A small value warns against
one common effect. A large value only says that disagreement was not detected;
with few modalities the test has limited power.

### 6A. Calibrate and attribute

Freedman--Lane residual permutations hold the design fixed. The reduced model
without the tested term is fitted, its residuals are exchanged within any
declared exchangeability blocks, and the full model is refitted to the rebuilt
score. One permutation is shared across concepts in a modality, preserving the
dependence caused by overlapping feature sets.

`p_value` is concept-specific. `p_family` compares the concept with the largest
statistic anywhere in the vocabulary and controls family-wise error. `q_value`
estimates the false-discovery rate among concepts at least this extreme.

Overlapping neighbours are then regressed from each concept score.
`attributed_z` asks whether the signal remains with that concept rather than
with the neighbourhood it shares.

## Branch B: families of related concepts

`chorale_concept_families()` groups concepts from their Jaccard overlap using
complete linkage. Family construction uses only the vocabulary and therefore
precedes testing. Every pair in a multi-concept family must meet the overlap
threshold; ungrouped concepts remain as singleton families.

`chorale_family_evidence()` sums the signed concept statistics and divides by
the square root of family size. Agreement accumulates and opposing directions
cancel. Calibration reuses the signed per-concept permutation array, which is
necessary because the family members overlap. A significant family means that
its members move together as a group; whether any one of them is significant on
its own is read from the concept table.

## Branch C: one low-rank state over the stacked collection

`chorale_joint_state()` starts from the same concept scores but estimates a
different object. Each concept is centred and scaled within each modality.
Optional modality-local nuisance columns, such as a batch recorded only in one
cohort, are regressed out before stacking. The phenotype is never allowed in
that nuisance list.

The score blocks are stacked by row. A concept unavailable in one modality is
stored as missing, not as zero, and carries no weight in the alternating
ridge-regularised least-squares fit. The result is a low-rank approximation with
one score per sample and one loading per concept.

Stacking supplies more observations and broader concept coverage than any
single modality. Component sign is arbitrary, component order can change between
fits, and different low-rank solutions may describe similar reconstructions, so a
component carries a mechanism only as far as its stability, loadings, phenotype
evidence, per-modality effects and transfer take it. Its label carries none.

`chorale_joint_evidence()` regresses the joint component scores on phenotype,
shared covariates, and modality. The modality term prevents differences in
cohort composition from masquerading as phenotype effects. Residual permutations
take place within modality. The same component is also described within each
modality, but those local effects are context, not a filtering rule.

## Branch D: test the direction where it was not fitted

`chorale_joint_transfer()` requires at least three modalities. It leaves one
modality out, fits the joint state on the remainder, projects the held-out
concept scores onto those loadings, and tests the projected scores in the
held-out design.

Each held-out decomposition has arbitrary order and sign. Components are
matched one-to-one to a full-data reference by the absolute correlation of
their concept loadings. `loading_agreement` retains the signed correlation. A
negative value means that the held-out fit points opposite to the reference;
the effect sign must be interpreted with that orientation. `p_value` is a
component-specific permutation p-value, not a family-wise correction over all
transferred components.

Transfer removes one explanation: structure unique to the held-out assay could
not have produced loadings fitted without that assay. Confounding shared across
the contributing studies survives it, and so does the distinction between
association and cause.

## Branch E: variation outside the vocabulary

The concept-score span is projected from each analysis matrix. ICA is fitted to
the residual, producing free dimensions that are orthogonal to the concept
scores. The count is selected by reproducibility under restarts and subsampling,
bounded by parallel analysis and sample size.

If the realised concept-score matrix has full row rank, it spans the centred
sample space and leaves no residual to decompose. Having at least as many
concepts as samples makes full row rank possible, but does not guarantee it.
An empty free-dimension table therefore has two readings, “not estimable because
no residual remained” and “tested and absent”, which `variance.tsv` separates.

## What the controls do

Phenotype residual permutations calibrate the reported tests. The modality
shuffle is descriptive because it changes feature support, cohort sizes, and
design composition; it carries no p-value. Initialisation stability reports
whether free dimensions reappear. `chorale_concept_specificity()` separately
tests whether shared covariates drive the vocabulary as strongly as phenotype.

Exchangeability blocks, phenotype reference, nuisance variables and the
vocabulary are study decisions, and the calibration is conditional on them.
Significance is read against those decisions rather than in place of them.
